input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
input.rationale: Garman's ownership of its own Software platform is acceptable, but Section 13 also vests the Modifications — the bespoke changes specified in Schedule \"D\" and paid for by Sparkling under the Fee Schedule — in Garman, with no assignment and no licence-back. The only rights Sparkling receives are the Section 2 licence (non-exclusive, non-transferable, confined to the AS400s at Authorized Locations and terminable) read with the Section 3 restrictions (no sublicence, no modification). That falls short of both the preferred position (Customer owns deliverables created for it) and the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables). The Agreement also contains no statement that Sparkling retains rights in its own data, even though Garman converts and processes that data under Section 4. Redline assigns the paid-for Modifications to Sparkling, adds a licence-back to embedded Garman IP, confirms Sparkling's data remains Sparkling's, and excludes joint ownership; the licence-only fallback is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Carve bespoke Modifications and Sparkling's data out of Garman's blanket IP ownership; add assignment, licence-back and no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 13 vests everything, including the Modifications we commission and pay for under Schedule "D", in Garman with only the restricted, location-limited licence in Section 2 and no rights in our own data. We are content for Garman to keep its platform, but we need ownership of the paid-for Modifications, a licence back to any embedded Garman IP, confirmation that our data stays ours, and no joint ownership. If assignment is not workable, we can accept a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Modifications instead.

ops.newText: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. Except as expressly provided in this Section 13, no title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement. Garman hereby assigns to Sparkling all intellectual property rights in the Modifications and any other deliverables developed for Sparkling and paid for by Sparkling under this Agreement, and, notwithstanding Section 3, grants Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense any Garman intellectual property embedded in or required to use those Modifications and deliverables for the purposes of Sparkling's business. Nothing in this Agreement transfers to Garman any right, title or interest in Sparkling's data or other information supplied by or on behalf of Sparkling, all of which remains the property of Sparkling. No intellectual property created under this Agreement shall be jointly owned.
